handoff: Approve: AC1-AC7 each proven by a test that asserts it, AC8 (repo mapping and docs) in place for QA; 1 minor note — the docs/reference.md mapping can drop a story's hand-written prose there.

findings.title: docs/reference.md is only partly generated: taking its base side drops a story's hand-written edits there
findings.detail:
packages/cli/scripts/docs-emit.ts:1 rewrites only the generated block of docs/reference.md. When a base update conflicts in docs/reference.md, packages/cli/src/runtime/integrate.ts:223 takes the base side of the whole file and docs:emit then restores only the generated block, so a story's edits to the hand-written Config prose (as this slice made) are silently lost; packages/core/src/update-outcome.ts:401 then counts the merge clean (trailer + mapped path) and the ready approval carries over with no review. User story 68 and D13 ask for exactly this mapping, so it is not a spec breach; it is a hazard for the person to weigh.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Either accept it, or map only fully generated files (drop docs/reference.md, or split its generated block into its own file) — a person's decision, not rework.
